# Litestone language surface

Generated by `litestone catalog --snapshot`. **Do not edit.**

Every word a `.lite` file can hold, with where it is legal and what its
arguments accept. The completeness of this table is asserted against the
parser by `test/catalog.test.ts`; this file is the other question — what
changed. Blurbs are deliberately absent: prose churns on wording, and a
snapshot that reshuffles on an edited sentence is one nobody reads.

## Positions

Which switch parses a word is not the same question as where it is legal.
A blank `legal` column above means the ordinary answer for that level.

| position | refuses |
| --- | --- |
| on a type's field | `id`, `unique`, `map`, `relation`, `generated`, `from`, `encrypted`, `guarded`, `secret`, `updatedAt`, `version`, `allow`, `values`, `scale`, `money`, `big` |
| on a trait's field | `id` |
| in a trait | `id`, `map`, `db`, `fts` |
| on an enum member | everything except `@label` |

## The visibility table

Three answers, one word. Asked as an interview in Studio.

| column | caller writes | caller reads | word |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | yes | *an ordinary column* |
| yes | yes | no | `@encrypted` |
| yes | no | yes | `@system` |
| yes | no | no | `@guarded` |
| no | no | yes | `@computed` |
| no | yes | no | `@transient` |
| no | no | no | *nothing at all* |
| no | yes | yes | *not expressible* |
| — | — | depends who asks | `@allow('read', …) on the field` |

## Rules

Shapes the parser accepts and something later refuses.

| id | severity | title |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `required-guarded-uncreatable` | error | a required @guarded column makes the model uncreatable |
| `required-system-unfilled` | warn | a required @system column has to be filled on every create |
| `gate-over-own-standing` | warn | the gate may let a caller rewrite the column it is graded from |
| `guarded-and-encrypted-is-secret` | info | @guarded with @encrypted is @secret written out |
| `fts-over-a-column-search-cannot-read` | error | a @@fts index names a column whose stored text is not the value |
| `foreign-key-without-index` | warn | a foreign key column with no index |
| `transition-to-a-state-nothing-reaches` | warn | an enum value no transition can reach |
| `label-column-that-may-be-null` | warn | @@label names a column that may be null |
| `unique-on-an-optional-column` | info | @unique on an optional column admits any number of nulls |
| `index-another-index-already-covers` | info | an index a longer one already answers |
| `declared-and-unreferenced` | info | a declaration nothing references |
